notes: Single source of truth for pstack-vic model families and parent routes. Consumers: runner (skills/poteto-mode/scripts/runner), setup-pstack, agents generator, provider-dispatch.md (rendered by scripts/render-model-matrix.ts).
A family is one line below. Adding a family = adding one line; the test suite derives everything else from this file.
efforts is the closed universe. Codex also exposes `ultra` (automatic task delegation); it is excluded because a pstack child never delegates.
cursorSlug is the Cursor pstack 0.15.2 selector this family replaces, with {effort} where the effort token goes; null when upstream has no such family.

transport is how the runner reaches a provider: `cli` (default) spawns providers.<name>.cli; `http` calls the provider's agents API from skills/poteto-mode/scripts/runner/http-lane.ts and needs cli null. The Cursor cloud API reports no served model, so its families pin by argv.

reportedModel is the regex a runner receipt's provider-reported model must match to count as verified; null when the CLI does not report the served model (Codex pins by argv). Grok Build CLI 1.0.5 reports the served model with a build suffix (`grok-4.6-build`, measured 2026-09-17), so the grok pattern accepts one.

roles are the per-role first-run defaults every skill cites by label (the same labels /setup-pstack writes to the model sheet). A value is an alias, `family@effort`, a list of those for a panel, or an object keyed by parent when the default depends on the parent (frontier solo roles use the parent's native frontier family). Skills never spell descriptors; they name the role and point at the rendered role table in provider-dispatch.md. description is the one-line account of what a lane in that role does; /setup-pstack shows it in the question for the role and the role table renders it.

roles.description: Writes the code of a feature or a behavior-preserving refactor in its own worktree; the parent reviews the diff.
Reproduces a reported defect, finds the root cause, and writes the fix with runtime evidence.
Traces a measured slowness against a baseline and implements the improvement.
Iterates hypotheses on one metric with before/after measurements, one commit per accepted win.
Writes and judges prose: docs, PR descriptions, summaries, explanations, syntheses.
Implements the hardest changes: cross-cutting design, subtle concurrency or algorithms, vague intent, or a precise multi-step sequence.
Reads a subsystem in read-only mode and reports how it works, with file and line evidence.
Turns the explorers' findings into the explanation the how skill delivers.
Investigate why something was built this way across git history, tickets, and the parent's MCP sources; needs the parent's MCPs, so it stays on an alias.
Merges the why investigators' findings into one answer; same MCP constraint, stays on an alias.
Reads transcripts and skills to find lessons after a long task with the parent's tools; stays on an alias for the MCP reason.
Judges, dissents on, and synthesizes the lessons the reflect skill captures; stays on an alias for the MCP reason.
Each lane attempts the same task in parallel; the arena picks a base and grafts the strongest parts of the others. One lane per entry.
Judges the arena candidates; the arena picks a provider different from the parent and the base candidate when possible.
Default worker for every swarm lane: coverage matrices, races, gauntlets, exploration partitions.
Each lane proposes a design (types, module shape) for the same problem before implementation. One lane per entry.
Each lane reviews the diff adversarially from its own angle; a different provider per lane widens the blind spots covered.
Runs the gates and the live lane of a ready PR and reconciles evidence against claims; never writes code.
Reads the base-to-head diff of a PR that touches an irreversible or contained class and reports regressions with a failure scenario and file and line.
Repairs one named cause of a single file, a lint or type failure, or a confirmed finding with a concrete disproof, in the PR branch.
Repairs a cross-file or behavior-changing cause in the PR branch; the second and last attempt.
Read-only diagnosers that each name the root cause of a failed fix with evidence; two that agree decide.
